About.heroSubtitle: A journey of passion towards true medical beauty
About.storyText1: Dr.Berry was born from a genuine passion for effective medical beauty. We believe every person deserves the best care backed by science and nature combined.
About.storyText2: Our products are made with certified medical formulas, combining the finest natural ingredients with the latest discoveries in dermatology and cosmetic science.
About.missionText: To make premium medical care accessible to everyone, while maintaining the highest standards of quality and safety.
About.visionText: To become the first choice in medical skincare and haircare products across the Arab world.
About.value1Desc: Every product undergoes rigorous quality testing before reaching you
About.value2Desc: Pure ingredients backed by modern science and medical research
About.value3Desc: A dedicated team to help you choose the perfect care routine
About.value4Desc: Luxury packaging delivered safely and swiftly anywhere
